pairs: I have waited expectantly for the Lord,
and he was attentive to me.
Et exaudivit preces meas, et eduxit me de lacu miseriæ et de luto fæcis.
And he heard my prayers and he led me out of the pit of misery and the quagmire.
Et statuit super petram pedes meos,
And he stationed my feet upon a rock,
Et immisit in os meum canticum novum,
And he sent a new canticle into my mouth,
and they will hope in the Lord.
Beatus vir cujus est nomen Domini spes ejus,
Blessed is the man whose hope is in the name of the Lord,
et non respexit in vanitates et insanias falsas.
and who has no respect for vanities and absurd falsehoods.
You have accomplished your many wonders,
and there is no one similar to you in your thoughts.
et cogitationibus tuis non est qui similis sit tibi.
But you have perfected ears for me.
In capite libri scriptum est de me,
At the head of the book, it has been written of me:
that I should do your will.
et legem tuam in medio cordis mei.
And your law is in the midst of my heart.
Annuntiavi justitiam tuam in ecclesia magna;
I have announced your justice in a great Church: behold,
I will not restrain my lips. O Lord,
Justitiam tuam non abscondi in corde meo;
I have not concealed your justice within my heart.
veritatem tuam et salutare tuum dixi;
I have spoken your truth and your salvation.
non abscondi misericordiam tuam et veritatem tuam a concilio multo.
I have not concealed your mercy and your truth from a great assembly.
do not take your tender mercies far from me.
ne longe facias miserationes tuas a me;
misericordia tua et veritas tua semper susceperunt me.
and your truth ever sustain me.
Quoniam circumdederunt me mala quorum non est numerus;
For evils without number have surrounded me.
My iniquities have taken hold of me,
and I was not able to see.
Multiplicatæ sunt super capillos capitis mei,
They have been multiplied beyond the hairs of my head.
And my heart has forsaken me.
Let them together be confounded and awed,
qui quærunt animam meam ut auferant eam;
who seek after my soul to steal it away.
Let them be turned back and be in awe,
Let them bear their confusion all at once,
Exsultent et lætentur super te omnes quærentes te;
Let all who seek you exult
And let those who love your salvation always say,
Ego autem mendicus sum et pauper;
But I am a beggar and poor.
The Lord has been concerned about me.
Adjutor meus et protector meus tu es;
You are my helper and my protector.
